source_columns: survey_year, EMtint002, EMtint005, DHuint005, DChint005, DHuint001, FFtint005, IChcbl001
expression:
local({
  rel <- coalesce(haven::zap_labels(DHuint005), haven::zap_labels(DChint005))
  mq <- haven::zap_labels(EMtint002)
  mrel <- haven::zap_labels(EMtint005)
  nocapi <- haven::zap_labels(DHuint001) %in% 0
  case_when(
    survey_year == 2010 & mq == 1 ~ "Mother",
    survey_year == 2010 & mq == 2 & mrel == 1 ~ "Father",
    survey_year == 2010 & mq == 2 & mrel %in% 2:12 ~ "Other carer",
    survey_year <= 2013 ~ "Unknown",
    rel == 1 ~ "Mother",
    rel == 2 ~ "Father",
    rel %in% 3:5 ~ "Other carer",
    nocapi & survey_year >= 2016 & mrel %in% 1 ~ "Mother",
    nocapi & haven::zap_labels(FFtint005) %in% 1 ~ "Father",
    nocapi & !is.na(IChcbl001) ~ "Unknown",
    nocapi ~ NA_character_,
    .default = "Unknown"
  )
})
notes: 2010: the mother questionnaire that reported screen time (EMtint002 'respondent is the mother', else EMtint005 relationship: father, or grandparent or other relative = Other carer). 2011-2013: the caregiver CAPI that reported screen time records no respondent (Unknown). 2014-2020: CAPI respondent's relationship to the child (DHuint005 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020; DChint005 2015, 2017, 2019); 2021-2023 (child-reported screen time): the CAPI respondent, the main parent interview. Grandparents, siblings and other relatives = Other carer. Rows with no CAPI take the mother questionnaire's respondent where it is the mother (EMtint005), else the father questionnaire's (FFtint005), else Unknown where only the CBCL was returned (IChcbl001); NA for child-only participants with no parent component.

source_columns: DHuses006, DHuses008, DHuses014, DHuses022, DHuses024, DHuses029, survey_year
expression:
local({
  comp <- case_when(
    survey_year == 2011 ~ na_if(na_if(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(DHuses008)), 99999999), 88888888) +
      na_if(na_if(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(DHuses014)), 99999999), 88888888) +
      na_if(na_if(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(DHuses022)), 99999999), 88888888) +
      na_if(na_if(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(DHuses024)), 99999999), 88888888),
    survey_year == 2012 ~ na_if(na_if(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(DHuses008)), 99999999), 88888888) +
      na_if(na_if(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(DHuses014)), 99999999), 88888888) +
      na_if(na_if(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(DHuses022)), 99999999), 88888888) +
      na_if(na_if(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(DHuses029)), 99999999), 88888888)
  )
  inc <- coalesce(comp, na_if(na_if(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(DHuses006)), 99999999), 88888888))
  lo <- stats::ave(inc, survey_year, FUN = function(v) stats::quantile(v, 0.4, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  hi <- stats::ave(inc, survey_year, FUN = function(v) stats::quantile(v, 0.6, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  case_when(inc <= lo ~ "Low", inc <= hi ~ "Medium", inc > hi ~ "High", .default = "Unknown")
})
notes: Monthly household income in 10,000 KRW, open-ended, caregiver interview (DHuses006), cut 40/20/40 on the unweighted rows within wave (at or below the 40th percentile Low, above the 60th High). 2011-2012 asked income by source instead: the sum of earned or business, private transfer, asset and other (2011) or public transfer (2012) income (DHuses008, 014, 022, 024, 029), complete-case, else the tidier's carried DHuses006 (nearest interview within 12 months). Don't know and no response set to NA; no value = Unknown. No value carried into or out of 2018-2023 (no interview dates). Proximate: heaped incomes put over 50% of rows at or below the 40th percentile in 2010, 2014 and 2020, with Medium at 6-9% in 2010 and 2014.

notes: 2016-2023 only. Caregiver report of a doctor's diagnosis of a chronic physical condition: congenital heart disease, epilepsy, diabetes, chronic sinusitis, chronic otitis media, chronic urinary tract infection, asthma and (from 2019) another chronic disease. Current: 2023 whether the child has each now (DChhlt051a-n); 2016-2022 regular or occasional hospital treatment for a told condition (DChhlt034a-n; asthma treatment KChasx014 in 2016). Told of any = told; Currently diagnosed if any told condition is current, Previously diagnosed if every told condition is not, NA if a told condition's treatment is unanswered. A blank year (2017-2022) where the caregiver answered the health section is read as never told. The ever-told ticks of 2010-2015 have no current/previous split and leave those waves NA, because other waves separate current from previous diagnosis. Atopic dermatitis, allergic rhinitis, food allergy and allergic conjunctivitis are named unused. Partial: treatment as the proxy for current in 2016-2022.
